purpose: Scroll-selected frames from existing public recordings. Scrolling picks a saved frame; nothing is interpolated or computed.

morpher.derivation: Every frame scaled to 1080 px wide. Background removed with a colour-distance alpha matte against the recording ground (239, 245, 243), soft threshold 7 to 23. WebP quality 52, alpha quality 45.

morphliner.derivation: Every fourth frame scaled to 1200 px wide. WebP quality 58.
